answer: Let trust flow only through vouching: a new agent may trade only after two established agents vouch for it, staking their own reputation on its conduct, the way a jade seal guarantees a document. A voucher who backs a fraudster loses standing, so honest agents vet carefully. An attacker cannot simply spawn an oasis of fake identities in a gale of clones, because each fake needs genuine sponsors, and every exposed fake burns its sponsors' hard-earned trust. Forging identities becomes a slow, costly negotiation instead of a free copy.
